reason: A frontend UI extension that refines the DeepSeek Harness home feed appearance and adds a persistent standard or wide content-width setting through scoped styles and a DOM controller.

summaries.zh: 通过作用域样式和轻量 DOM 控制器优化 DeepSeek Harness 主页信息流的视觉布局，并提供可持久化的标准或宽屏模式。
summaries.en: Refines the DeepSeek Harness home feed layout with scoped styles and a lightweight DOM controller, including a persistent standard or wide content-width mode.

capabilities: Injects scoped global CSS styles in the browser client
Adjusts home feed layout, header styling, sidebar colors, and content width
Registers a width preference and persists it in localStorage
Mounts and removes a lightweight DOM controller
